headline: 创刊号 · 今天三件大事：① 杰克逊霍尔全球央行年会明天开幕（8月27-29日），美联储主席沃什周五发表主旨演讲——在上月三位官员投出加息异议票之后，这场演讲被市场视为对美联储政策信誉的考验；② IMF 最新《世界经济展望》：2026 年全球增长 3%，警告「去通胀进程已停滞」；③ 香港方向全是好消息——政府上周把全年增长预测上调至 3.5%-4.5%，汇丰、瑞银、渣打集体跟进上调。

reports.title: World Economic Outlook Update, July 2026: Global Economy in Crosscurrents of War and Technology

points.en: The global outlook is being shaped by two powerful forces pulling in opposite directions: the lingering effects of the energy shock from the war in the Middle East and a technology-driven investment boom.
points.zh: 全球经济前景正被两股方向相反的力量塑造：中东战争带来的能源冲击的持续影响，与技术驱动的投资热潮。

points.en: We are projecting global growth of 3 percent in 2026 and 3.4 percent in 2027, broadly unchanged from April on a cumulative basis.
points.zh: 我们预计 2026 年全球增长 3%、2027 年增长 3.4%，累计口径与 4 月预测大体持平。

points.en: Global headline inflation has been revised up to 4.7 percent this year... the disinflation trend that has been in place since early 2024 has stalled.
points.zh: 今年全球整体通胀预测被上调至 4.7%……自 2024 年初持续至今的去通胀进程已经陷入停滞。

points.en: In effect, we expect a V-shaped recovery, weaker growth this year relative to our pre-war forecast, followed by a rebound next year.
points.zh: 实际上，我们预计一场 V 型复苏：今年增长弱于战前预测，明年出现反弹。

reports.note: 报告全名《战争与科技的交叉流》。中国 2026 年增速被上调 0.2 个百分点至 4.6%，是少数获上调的主要经济体（高技术制造业与出口拉动）；美国维持 2.3%，欧元区下调至 0.9%；全球贸易增速预计从去年的 5% 放缓至今年的 3.5%。

reports.orgZh: 香港特区政府 · 汇丰 · 瑞银 · 渣打
reports.title: Hong Kong raises 2026 GDP forecast to 3.5–4.5% on AI trade boom

points.en: The Hong Kong economy posted the strongest half-yearly performance in nearly five years, as GDP grew 5.1 percent year-on-year in the first half.
points.zh: 香港经济创出近五年最强的半年度表现：上半年 GDP 同比增长 5.1%。

points.en: Goods exports recorded double-digit growth for five consecutive quarters, underpinned by robust trade flows and strong global demand for AI-related electronic products.
points.zh: 在强劲的贸易流与全球对 AI 相关电子产品的旺盛需求支撑下，货物出口已连续五个季度实现双位数增长（二季度实质同比 +28.9%）。

points.en: The AI-demand cycle has kept Hong Kong's external trade resilient, and consumption should remain steady, supported by improving wealth effects and stable monetary conditions. — Erin Xin, HSBC
points.zh: AI 需求周期使香港对外贸易保持韧性；在财富效应改善与货币环境稳定的支撑下，消费应保持平稳。（汇丰大中华区高级经济学家 Erin Xin）

points.en: A lower supply of housing units and continuing inflow of new residents should both support the residential real estate sector, while a strong IPO pipeline should keep financial market activity elevated. — J. Safra Sarasin
points.zh: 新房供应减少与新居民持续流入都将支撑住宅楼市，而强劲的 IPO 上市管道将令金融市场活动保持活跃。（瑞士银行 J. Safra Sarasin）

reports.note: 预测大合唱：特区政府 2.5%-3.5% 上调至 3.5%-4.5%；瑞银 3.3%→4.5%；汇丰 3.8%→4.5%；渣打 4.3%；东亚银行 3.8%。港府经济学家指 AI 相关产品约占香港商品出口约 70%，二季度价值同比 +63.7%（上季度 +41.5%）。

reports.orgZh: 美联储 · 杰克逊霍尔年会前瞻
reports.title: Jackson Hole 2026: Financial Innovation — Implications for Payments and Policy

points.en: The Fed left rates unchanged in the 3.50–3.75 percent range for a fifth consecutive month, though three members dissented in favour of a hike.
points.zh: 美联储连续第五个月把利率维持在 3.50%-3.75% 区间不变，但有三位官员投下异议票、主张加息——这是 2016 年以来首次三位官员集体异议。

points.en: Chair Kevin Warsh continued to emphasise data dependence and the Fed's unwavering commitment to price stability, while reiterating that the Committee is "not constrained by market prices".
points.zh: 主席沃什继续强调数据依赖与美联储对价格稳定的坚定承诺，并重申委员会「不受市场定价约束」。

points.en: The US interest rates market is set to finish the week pricing in 9 bp of rate hikes for the Fed's September meeting and a total of 23 bp of tightening for the remainder of 2026.
points.zh: 美国利率市场本周收尾时为美联储 9 月会议定价约 9 个基点的加息、2026 年剩余时间累计约 23 个基点的紧缩。

points.en: J.P. Morgan Wealth Management strategists now expect a 25-basis-point hike in September, while Goldman Sachs chief economist Jan Hatzius argues a September hike is "very unlikely" — a rare, sharp divergence between top banks.
points.zh: 摩根大通财富管理现预计 9 月加息 25 个基点，而高盛首席经济学家哈祖斯认为 9 月加息「非常不可能」——顶级投行出现罕见的尖锐分歧。

reports.note: 年会 8 月 27-29 日举行，官方主题「金融创新：对支付与政策的影响」（聚焦数字支付、稳定币、资产代币化）；沃什 8 月 28 日（周五）发表主旨演讲。背景数据：7 月 CPI 同比 3.4%（前值 3.5%），仍远高于 2% 目标；30 年期美债收益率一度突破 5.3%，创 2007 年以来新高。

reports.title: Global Banking AI Benchmark 2026: The ROE Gap Widens

points.en: Banks in the top quartile of AI adoption generated 3.1 percentage points of additional return on equity compared to the bottom quartile — a gap that has widened from 1.4 points in 2023.
points.zh: AI 应用程度最高四分位的银行，其 ROE（股本回报率）比最低四分位高出 3.1 个百分点——这一差距较 2023 年的 1.4 个百分点继续拉大。

points.en: The ROI curve is non-linear: institutions that crossed the "integration threshold" — AI embedded in more than 60 percent of customer-facing processes — showed compounding returns, while those below the threshold showed marginal gains.
points.zh: 投资回报曲线是非线性的：跨过「整合门槛」（AI 嵌入超过 60% 的客户触点流程）的机构呈现复利式回报，门槛之下的机构收益甚微。

points.en: We are in a moment where the technology moves in quarters and the regulatory framework moves in decades. — Chintan Mehta, Chief AI Officer, Wells Fargo
points.zh: 我们正处在一个技术以「季度」演进、而监管框架以「数十年」演进的时代。（富国银行首席 AI 官 Chintan Mehta）

reports.note: 该基准覆盖 28 个国家/地区的 340 家机构。另据斯坦福 HAI 与麦肯锡全球研究院年中调查：2026 年上半年全球企业 AI 支出约 3,120 亿美元、同比 +41%，金融业平均支出居各行业之首。

terms.defEn: A slowdown in the rate of inflation — prices are still rising, but more slowly than before.
terms.defZh: 通胀速度的放缓——物价仍在上涨，但涨得比以前慢。注意不等于 deflation（通货紧缩，物价整体下跌）。
terms.exEn: The disinflation trend that has been in place since early 2024 has stalled. — IMF
terms.exZh: 自 2024 年初持续至今的去通胀进程已经陷入停滞。

terms.defEn: Describing a policy stance that leans toward tighter monetary policy (such as raising rates) to fight inflation. The opposite is "dovish".
terms.defZh: 偏向收紧货币政策（如加息）以对抗通胀的政策立场。反义词是 dovish（鸽派的，偏向宽松/降息）。央行观察的必修词。
terms.exEn: The July FOMC meeting had a hawkish tilt, with three members dissenting in favour of a hike.
terms.exZh: 7 月议息会议基调偏鹰，三位官员投出支持加息的异议票。

terms.defEn: An official disagreement with the majority decision — for example, when a Fed policymaker votes against the committee's rate decision.
terms.defZh: 对多数决定的正式不同意——例如美联储官员对委员会的利率决议投反对票。FOMC 新闻里高频出现。
terms.exEn: Three members dissented in favour of a hike — the first such collective dissent since 2016.
terms.exZh: 三位官员投下支持加息的异议票——这是自 2016 年以来首次出现这样的集体异议。

terms.defEn: One hundredth of one percent (0.01%). A 25-basis-point rate change equals 0.25%.
terms.defZh: 0.01 个百分点。加息 25 个基点 = 加息 0.25%。投行报告里几乎每页都有，常缩写为 bp / bps。
terms.exEn: The US interest rates market is pricing in 9 bp of rate hikes for the September meeting.
terms.exZh: 美国利率市场为 9 月会议定价了 9 个基点的加息。

terms.defEn: The tendency of people to spend more when the value of their assets (stocks, property) rises, because they feel richer.
terms.defZh: 当股票、房产等资产升值时，人们「感觉自己更有钱」于是增加消费的现象。在香港语境里常与楼市、股市走势连用。
terms.exEn: Consumption should remain steady, supported by improving wealth effects and stable monetary conditions. — HSBC
terms.exZh: 在财富效应改善与货币环境稳定的支撑下，消费应保持平稳。

terms.defEn: Goods imported into a place and then shipped out again with little processing — a classic trade model for Hong Kong.
terms.defZh: 货物进口后再出口、基本不做深加工——香港贸易的经典模式（转口贸易）。
terms.exEn: The AI "super cycle" continues to lift Hong Kong's re-export trade. — Standard Chartered (观点改写)
terms.exZh: AI「超级周期」持续拉动香港转口贸易回暖。

terms.defEn: An unusually long and strong boom in demand or prices across an industry or the whole economy.
terms.defZh: 一个行业或整个经济体异常持久、强劲的需求/价格繁荣周期。渣打用词，近月被广泛引用。
terms.exEn: The AI industry has opened up a super cycle that keeps lifting Hong Kong's trade performance.
terms.exZh: AI 产业开启的行业超级周期，持续提振香港的贸易表现。

terms.zh: IPO 上市管道 · 名词
terms.defEn: The set of companies lined up to go public (list their shares on an exchange) in the coming months.
terms.defZh: 排队准备在未来几个月上市的公司集合。管道强 = 投行承销、交易所、财富管理业务都受益——香港金融圈常谈。
terms.exEn: A strong IPO pipeline should keep financial market activity elevated. — J. Safra Sarasin
terms.exZh: 强劲的 IPO 管道应能使金融市场活动保持活跃。

interview.q: 银行产品经理面：「为什么现在想加入香港的银行？」
interview.en: Hong Kong is getting a clear tailwind from the AI super cycle — AI-related products now make up about 70 percent of the city's merchandise exports. For retail banking, the resulting wealth effect supports deposits, wealth management and cross-border demand — exactly the product areas I want to grow in.
interview.zh: 一句话用上 super cycle、tailwind（顺风/利好）、wealth effect，还报得出「约 70%」这个港府经济学家给的数字——面试官会立刻感觉你真的在读报告。

interview.q: 咨询（数字转型）面：「银行数字转型项目你会从哪里切入？」
interview.en: The gap between AI leaders and laggards is compounding. McKinsey's banking benchmark shows top-quartile banks earn over 3 percentage points more return on equity, and the payoff only kicks in above the integration threshold. So I would focus on moving the client from scattered pilots to embedded, end-to-end adoption.
interview.zh: 用上 compounding（复利式扩大）、top quartile（前四分位）、integration threshold——「先讲门槛、再谈方案」正是咨询顾问最爱的结构化思维。

interview.q: 常见市场观点题：「你怎么看现在的美联储？」
interview.en: The Fed has held rates at 3.5 to 3.75 percent, and with three dissents in favour of a hike, the tone has clearly turned hawkish. My base case is higher-for-longer: the real risk is that disinflation stalls around 3 percent, still far above target.
interview.zh: 十五秒内用上 hold、dissent、hawkish、higher-for-longer（利率高位更久）、disinflation——这题几乎每家金融机构终面都会问，值得背熟。

tip: 读报告学英语的正确姿势：每句英文先自己读 2-3 遍、遮住中文复述大意，再对照翻译修正。今天 8 个词里，hawkish/dovish、basis point、wealth effect 是香港金融面试出现频率最高的三个，建议今晚睡前再快速过一遍。明天年会开幕，后天早上 8 点的晨读会帮你复盘沃什的演讲。
